description: Self-hosted Renovate (#2464): runs from the scheduled `renovate` job in .gitlab-ci.yml. See docs/maintainers/renovate.md. Never automerge: every bump is reviewed and merged by a human. Only the managers in enabledManagers run (Renovate's defaults would otherwise also pick up scripts/, docs/, docs-site/, .github/ and every image via gitlabci); ignorePaths keeps those trees out of the enabled managers' default file patterns. Majors are never grouped: the group rules match minor/patch only, so each major is its own MR. The one exception is the Playwright pair, which always moves together.

customManagers.description: The Playwright browser image in .gitlab-ci.yml (playwright-e2e). It is not behind ${DOCKERHUB_MIRROR}, so the rule above misses it, and the gitlabci manager is disabled; the 'playwright' package rule groups it with @playwright/test

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates per ecosystem. Python lock regeneration is the separate pip_requirements rule below (#2482)

Renovate's pip manager edits backend/requirements*.txt only; the Dockerfiles install the hash-pinned backend/requirements.lock, and backend-lock-check fails when it is stale. Regenerate both locks on the branch (#2482). Separate from the grouping rule so majors, which are never grouped, get it too. The command must match RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS on the renovate job in .gitlab-ci.yml; that job installs uv at the version pinned in scripts/uv-requirements.txt
clients/typescript documents Node >=20.3 as its floor (#2374); the CI images stay on node 20 on purpose
The Renovate image pin in .gitlab-ci.yml (renovate job) and the renovate@ pin in renovate-config-check move together by hand; the regex manager must not bump one half
A PostgreSQL major changes the on-disk format and needs pg_upgrade or a dump and restore; it is never proposed automatically, in Compose, Dockerfiles, CI images or the Helm values
eslint-plugin-unicorn 66+ requires ESLint 10; the repo is on ESLint 9. Re-enable when the ESLint major is bumped

@playwright/test and the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright CI image must be the same version (the client refuses browsers from another release), so they move in one MR, majors included. Last, so it overrides the per-ecosystem groups
